blueprint.name: AWS EKS + BNK 2.3 Traffic-Ready
blueprint.description: One-field deploy: provisions a new AWS EKS cluster and installs the full BNK 2.3 platform (HP TMM node pool, Multus, hugepages, cert-manager, FLO, CNEInstance, license gate). Only the cluster name is required; all credentials and operational settings are resolved automatically.

estimated_cost: AWS usage-based (EKS control plane + 3× m6i.4xlarge workers + 1× c5n.4xlarge HP node + NAT gateway)

prerequisites.name: aws_credentials
prerequisites.description: AWS credentials with VPC, EKS, and IAM create privileges.

optional.name: aws_access_key_id
optional.description: AWS access key ID (auto-filled from credential template).

optional.name: aws_secret_access_key
optional.description: AWS secret access key (auto-filled from credential template).

optional.name: aws_region
optional.description: AWS region (auto-filled from project).

optional.name: aws_session_token
optional.description: AWS session token (auto-filled from credential template; empty for static keys).

optional.name: jwt_token
optional.description: F5 BNK license JWT (resolved from project secret).

optional.name: cne_pull_secret
optional.description: F5 FAR registry pull credentials (resolved from project secret).

optional.name: worker_instance_type
optional.description: Worker node instance type.

optional.name: worker_count_per_az
optional.description: Worker nodes per AZ.

optional.name: hp_instance_type
optional.description: HP TMM node instance type.

optional.name: hp_node_count_per_az
optional.description: HP TMM nodes per AZ.

optional.name: deployment_size
optional.description: CNEInstance deployment size (Small / Medium / Large / Max).

optional.name: tmm_replicas
optional.description: TMM replicas.

optional.name: vip_cidr
optional.description: VIP CIDR for BNK Gateway (empty = auto-discover from HP-node TMM subnets).

optional.name: instance_namespace
optional.description: CNEInstance namespace.

optional.name: instance_name
optional.description: CNEInstance CR name.

optional.name: license_namespace
optional.description: Namespace for the BNK License CR (must match FLO/operator namespace).

optional.name: activation_timeout_seconds
optional.description: Max seconds to wait for License .status.state == Active before failing closed.

optional.name: additional_ips_per_eni
optional.description: Additional private IPs allocated on EACH secondary ENI at creation. 0 = let cneinstall's IPAM manage allocation.

optional.name: availability_zone_count
optional.description: Number of AZs the cluster spans. Auto-wired from cluster-register; used as the natural ceiling for the smart tmm_replicas default.

optional.name: availability_zones
optional.description: AZs to spread HP nodes across.

optional.name: bnk_gateway_name
optional.description: Name of the BNKGateway CR (kind: F5BnkGateway).

optional.name: bnk_manifest_version
optional.description: BNK manifest version to download from FAR (e.g. 2.3.0-3.2598.3-0.0.170). Must start with X.Y.Z- format.

optional.name: ca_certificate_name
optional.description: Name of the CA Certificate resource

optional.name: ca_duration
optional.description: Requested CA certificate duration

optional.name: ca_renew_before
optional.description: Renewal window before CA certificate expiry

optional.name: ca_secret_name
optional.description: Secret name that stores the generated CA keypair

optional.name: cainjector_replicas
optional.description: Number of cert-manager cainjector replicas

optional.name: cert_manager_ready
optional.description: Dependency gate from cert-manager (ensures CRDs exist before FLO references the ClusterIssuer).

optional.name: cert_manager_version
optional.description: Jetstack cert-manager chart version

optional.name: cloud_az_subnet_mappings
optional.description: AWS AZ → subnet mapping for the cloud-network-mapping ConfigMap. Auto-wired from eks-cluster-register.cloud_az_subnet_mappings — discovered from the EKS cluster's own VPC config, so users don't have to re-enter what EKS already knows.

optional.name: cluster_issuer_name
optional.description: Name of the CA-backed ClusterIssuer for BNK components

optional.name: cluster_name
optional.description: Name of the Kubernetes cluster. Auto-wired from the cloud cluster module when available.

optional.name: cluster_oidc_issuer_url
optional.description: OIDC issuer URL of the EKS cluster.

optional.name: cne_crd_name
optional.description: Fully-qualified CNEInstance CRD name for the CRD pre-gate.

optional.name: cneinstall_ready
optional.description: Ordering gate from cneinstall.host_device_applied — heals run after the CNEInstance is applied.

optional.name: condition_timeout_seconds
optional.description: Max seconds to wait for the readiness conditions before failing closed.

optional.name: container_platform
optional.description: Container platform value passed to FLO. AWS enables cloud-aware gRPC and networking behavior — different from the upstream bnk/flo default of 'Generic'.

optional.name: controller_replicas
optional.description: Number of cert-manager controller replicas

optional.name: crd_timeout_seconds
optional.description: Max seconds to wait for the CNEInstance CRD to be registered.

optional.name: crds_installed
optional.description: Dependency gate from FLO — BNK CRDs must be registered before applying CNEInstance.

optional.name: daemonset_rollout_timeout
optional.description: kubectl rollout status timeout for the hugepages-setup DaemonSet to be Ready. Default 300s matches awsbnkctl Phase 11b hugepagesReadyTimeout.

optional.name: eks_cluster_version
optional.description: EKS Kubernetes minor version (e.g. '1.30'). Empty = community module picks the latest stable.

optional.name: endpoint_public_access_cidrs
optional.description: Source CIDRs allowed to reach the EKS public API endpoint. Default 0.0.0.0/0 (open — Forge reaches the API from a variable NAT egress IP). Hardening: set to operator/jumphost CIDRs. Private endpoint always on. See ledger D-031 SECURITY NOTE.

optional.name: external_eni_device_index
optional.description: Device index for the TMM-external secondary ENI. 2 → ens7 on AL2023 (matches ens7-ipvlan-l2 NAD default).

optional.name: external_ifname
optional.description: External TMM ENI ifname (host-device CNEInstance env). Auto-wired from tmm-nads.external_ifname.

optional.name: external_pci
optional.description: External TMM ENI PCI bus id (PCIDEVICE_INTEL_COM_<IF>). Auto-wired from tmm-nads.external_pci.

optional.name: external_selfip
optional.description: External TMM SelfIP (ext-vlan F5SPKVlan). Empty disables the host-device F5SPKVlan/GatewayClass step. Auto-wired from tmm-nads.external_selfip.

optional.name: f5_license_proxy_url
optional.description: F5 License Proxy URL — used only when license_mode is 'f5licenseproxy'.

optional.name: far_secret_name
optional.description: FAR image pull secret name. Auto-wired from bnk-prereqs.

optional.name: flo_namespace
optional.description: Namespace for FLO deployment. Auto-wired from bnk-prereqs.operator_namespace.

optional.name: flo_ready
optional.description: Dependency gate from FLO module — must be true before applying CNEInstance.

optional.name: flo_version
optional.description: FLO Helm chart version. Auto-wired from the BNK manifest parsed by bnk-prereqs.

optional.name: forge_kubeconfig_content
optional.description: Kubeconfig YAML content. Auto-injected by BNK-Forge from the selected cluster. Set manually for standalone usage.

optional.name: gateway_namespace
optional.description: Namespace for Gateway API resources (Gateway, HTTPRoute, etc.).

optional.name: install_hugepages
optional.description: Apply the hugepages-setup DaemonSet. Set false if hugepages are already configured on the cluster's BNK nodes.

optional.name: install_multus
optional.description: Apply the upstream multus-daemonset. Set false if Multus is already installed on the cluster.

optional.name: instance_type
optional.description: EC2 instance type. Must support at least 3 total ENIs (primary + 2 secondary). m5n.large (default) supports 3; m5n.xlarge/c5n.xlarge support 4+.

optional.name: internal_eni_device_index
optional.description: Device index for the TMM-internal secondary ENI. 3 → ens8 on AL2023 (matches ens8-ipvlan-l2 NAD default).

optional.name: internal_ifname
optional.description: Internal TMM ENI ifname. Auto-wired from tmm-nads.internal_ifname.

optional.name: internal_pci
optional.description: Internal TMM ENI PCI bus id. Auto-wired from tmm-nads.internal_pci.

optional.name: internal_selfip
optional.description: Internal TMM SelfIP (int-vlan F5SPKVlan). Auto-wired from tmm-nads.internal_selfip.

optional.name: kubeconfig_file
optional.description: Path to an existing kubeconfig. Empty = materialise from forge_kubeconfig_content.

optional.name: license_crd_name
optional.description: Fully-qualified License CRD name for the CRD pre-gate.

optional.name: license_mode
optional.description: License mode: 'connected' (talks to F5 license server) or 'f5licenseproxy' (talks to a local F5 License Proxy).

optional.name: license_name
optional.description: Name of the License CR to apply and poll.

optional.name: manifest_version
optional.description: BNK manifest version (referenced in the CNEInstance CR).

optional.name: multus_crd_wait_timeout
optional.description: Timeout for the NetworkAttachmentDefinition CRD to be Established.

optional.name: multus_manifest_url
optional.description: Explicit override for the multus-daemonset URL. Empty = build from multus_version.

optional.name: multus_ready
optional.description: Gate from eks-cluster-install-multus. Asserted true before host-device NADs are applied.

optional.name: multus_rollout_wait_timeout
optional.description: Timeout for the kube-multus-ds DaemonSet rollout.

optional.name: multus_version
optional.description: Multus release tag.

optional.name: nad_external_name
optional.description: External host-device NAD name (→ TMM trunk 1.1). Must match cneinstall network_attachments[0].

optional.name: nad_internal_name
optional.description: Internal host-device NAD name (→ TMM trunk 1.2). Must match cneinstall network_attachments[1].

optional.name: nad_namespace
optional.description: Namespace where the NADs are created (plus `default`). MUST match the CNEInstance namespace. Gold-standard split: f5-cne-system.

optional.name: namespace
optional.description: Namespace for cert-manager deployment

optional.name: network_attachments
optional.description: NAD names attached to TMM, in order: [0] → trunk 1.1 (external), [1] → trunk 1.2 (internal). Host-device NADs applied by tmm-nads.

optional.name: node_count_per_az
optional.description: Desired HP nodes per AZ. 0 = skip the node group entirely (subnets still created when tag_subnets_for_tmm = true).

optional.name: node_disk_size_gb
optional.description: Root volume size for HP nodes.

optional.name: node_label_app
optional.description: Value for the 'app' label on HP nodes; FLO matches this to schedule TMM pods.

optional.name: node_security_group_id
optional.description: Shared EKS node security group ID. Attached to the HP node group launch template so HP nodes land in the SAME SG as the default node group; otherwise EKS uses the cluster-managed SG and cross-node pod traffic (controller↔TMM gRPC) is dropped. Resolved from cluster-create's node_security_group_id output; empty for brownfield (register) → falls back to the EKS default. See ledger D-031 NEW FINDING #2.

optional.name: node_subnet_ids
optional.description: Private subnet IDs where the HP managed node group places its PRIMARY ENI. cluster-register and cluster-create both expose private_subnet_ids: register aliases it to the full subnet list (brownfield can't safely distinguish), create returns only the truly private subnets it provisioned. Either way HP nodes stay off public subnets. Both secondary ENIs land in dedicated TMM subnets via user-data.

optional.name: operation_mode
optional.description: License operationMode. Connected only.

optional.name: operator_namespace
optional.description: Operator namespace — FLO, License CR, OTEL/CWC. Gold-standard split: f5-cne-core. CNEInstance + CNE controller live in instance_namespace.

optional.name: otel_duration
optional.description: Requested OTEL certificate duration

optional.name: otel_f5ing_server_certificate_name
optional.description: Name of F5 ingestion OTEL certificate resource

optional.name: otel_f5ing_server_secret_name
optional.description: Secret name generated by F5 ingestion OTEL certificate

optional.name: otel_renew_before
optional.description: Renewal window before OTEL certificate expiry

optional.name: otel_server_certificate_name
optional.description: Name of OTEL server certificate resource

optional.name: otel_server_secret_name
optional.description: Secret name generated by OTEL server certificate

optional.name: poll_interval_seconds
optional.description: Seconds between condition-gate poll iterations.

optional.name: release_name
optional.description: Helm release name for cert-manager

optional.name: resources
optional.description: Optional cert-manager chart resources block (null uses chart defaults)

optional.name: self_signed_cluster_issuer_name
optional.description: Name of the bootstrap self-signed ClusterIssuer

optional.name: selfip_host_offset
optional.description: Host octet for the TMM SelfIP within each /24 TMM subnet (awsbnkctl uses .240).

optional.name: selfip_prefixlen
optional.description: TMM SelfIP prefix length. Auto-wired from tmm-nads.selfip_prefixlen.

optional.name: skip_iface_discovery
optional.description: Skip the privileged iface-discovery pod and use the deterministic device-index PCI fallback (ens8=0000:00:08.0, ens7=0000:00:07.0).

optional.name: storage_class_name
optional.description: StorageClass for CNEInstance persistent state.

optional.name: tag_private_subnets_for_tmm
optional.description: When true, tag private subnets with 'f5-bnk-role=tmm-external' so the cluster-create outputs (and downstream cneinstall) can auto-discover them for the BNKGateway CR's defaultListenerNetworks.

optional.name: tag_subnets_for_tmm
optional.description: Tag TMM-external subnets with 'f5-bnk-role=tmm-external' and TMM-internal subnets with 'f5-bnk-role=tmm-internal' for cneinstall auto-discovery.

optional.name: teem_cert_url
optional.description: TEEM cert URL (spec.teemCertUrl).

optional.name: teem_entitlement_url
optional.description: TEEM entitlement URL (spec.teemEntitlementUrl).

optional.name: teem_initial_config_url
optional.description: TEEM initial-config URL (spec.teemInitialConfigUrl).

optional.name: tmm_az
optional.description: AZ of the single TMM node — restricts cloud-network-mapping to one AZ. Auto-wired from tmm-nads.tmm_az.

optional.name: tmm_external_subnet_cidrs
optional.description: Explicit TMM-external subnet CIDRs. Empty list = auto-carve from vpc_cidr.

optional.name: tmm_external_subnets_by_az
optional.description: TMM external subnets per AZ, discovered by cluster-register via the AWS subnet tag 'f5-bnk-role=tmm-external'. Auto-wired; user shouldn't set this directly. Customers tag their TMM data-plane subnets in AWS, then the cneinstall module auto-builds the BNKGateway CR from those.

optional.name: tmm_internal_subnet_cidrs
optional.description: Explicit TMM-internal subnet CIDRs. Empty list = auto-carve from vpc_cidr.

optional.name: utils_namespace
optional.description: Namespace for utility components (e.g. IPAM if deployed separately).

optional.name: vip_network_name
optional.description: Logical name for the VIP listener network in the BNKGateway CR.

optional.name: vpc_cidr
optional.description: CIDR block for the new VPC. Default leaves room for /24 subnets per AZ.

optional.name: vpc_id
optional.description: Cluster VPC ID.

optional.name: watch_namespaces
optional.description: Which namespaces the CNE controller watches for Gateway/HTTPRoute CRs. ["All"] = everything.

optional.name: webhook_replicas
optional.description: Number of cert-manager webhook replicas

optional.name: worker_disk_size_gb
optional.description: Worker node root volume size.

optional.name: worker_node_count
optional.description: Total worker node count. Auto-wired from cluster-register; caps the smart tmm_replicas default (TMM pod can't schedule without a node).

optional.name: eks_cluster_name
optional.description: EKS cluster name (module-level alias — hides per-module eks_cluster_name vars that declare source:user).

optional.name: create_cluster_issuer
optional.description: Create self-signed ClusterIssuer (cert-manager module internal).

optional.name: create_otel_certs
optional.description: Create OTEL telemetry certificates via cert-manager (cert-manager module internal).
